module: 'Other/Vehicle Spawner' tool of the live Vehicle Editor. When the editor loads it remembers up to 20 vehicles (Car or Truck) from core_vehicles.getVehicleList. The window lets you spawn a vehicle at the camera position/orientation ('Select Vehicle' window), choose a point on the terrain (wheel = 5° rotation) then line up all the vehicles of the list there (spaced 10 m apart), and delete everything ('Despawn All').
notes: Vehicles spawn with the handbrake released (input.event('parkingbrake', 0, 1)).
Only the vehicles created by 'Spawn Vehicles' are tracked in vehsData and deleted by 'Despawn All'; those created from 'Select Vehicle' are not recorded.
Minor bug: `hit = cameraMouseRayCast(...)` is assigned without `local` (global `hit`).
One button per vehicle of vehsList: at most 20 models offered.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: draws the window, the start markers and the vehicle selection window.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Called at editor initialization: fills vehsList with the first 20 Car/Truck vehicles.
